title: Models As Tools
definition: Treating language models as tools to be utilized effectively, rather than as infallible sources of information or solutions.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Using AI models to help you solve problems, but understanding they're not always right and may need adjustments.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Recognizing the strengths and limitations of language models and utilizing them appropriately, based on the task at hand.
difficulty_levels.expert: Understanding that AI models are tools that can assist in solving complex problems, but they require careful management, evaluation, and sometimes collaboration with other tools to deliver optimal results.

extra_fields.insight: AI models are tools to help us, not replace us.
